title: From Specification to Silicon in Half the Time
summary: Turnkey design guide from Wipro shows how AI chip design and derivative silicon development reduce schedules costs and risk across semiconductor programs
body_markdown:
We shorten development cycles from 18 to 24 months to 9 to 12 months for derivative silicon. Our turnkey model reduces schedule risk and helps you deliver more portfolio value without significantly expanding your internal team.


**Why this eBook matters**


Semiconductor companies face rising complexity, limited talent availability, and pressure to release more variants for AI-driven markets.


Our AI-enabled turnkey approach helps you:


- Halve time to market for derivative designs


- Reduce R&D cost by approximately 25 percent


- Improve schedule predictability


- Scale execution with minimal headcount growth


- Strengthen software, system, and customer engineering support


**What you will learn**


- How derivative design accelerates portfolio growth


- Where AI delivers meaningful gains in design and verification


- What truly end-to-end turnkey execution looks like


- How predictable schedules protect downstream revenue


- Examples informed by leading semiconductor programs
